newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae to buy $100 mln Chase mortgage loans.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae to buy $100 mln Chase mortgage loans.

text.p: Federal National Mortgage Association said Monday it has committed to buy $100 million of mortgage loans originated by Chase Manhattan Corp's Chase Manhattan Mortgage Corp in four underserved metropolitan areas.

The alliance between the two insitutions will give access to financing needed by about 1,500 underserved and minority homebuyers in Chicago, Los Angeles, Miami and the Philadelphia/Camden area to put in as little as one percent of their own money toward downpayments, it said.
The National Association of Real Estate Brokers, which is also part of the alliance, will provide professional real estate services to the borrowers.
Under the experimental financing initiative that seeks to serve low- and moderate-income borrowers, two options are available.
The borrowers can qualify for a down payment of three percent, with one percent coming from their own pockets and two percent from a gift, grant or seller contribution.

The other way is to make a down payment of 5.0 percent in which the borrowers put in two percent of their own money and the remaining 3.0 -percent from a gift or unsecured loan from a party not involved in the transaction.
